summary: Sports-ground car park off the reserve access road, backed by playing fields.
reasons: Car park with cars parked, beside fields
Homes across main road, over 40 m

best_section.where: Sports car park about 60 m south of the pin, west of the access road

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto playing fields and clubhouse; nearest homes are across Cubberla Creek Road, well over 40 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed service road leads straight in; car park has parked cars and room for a van. Pin itself is a wooded bank.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end reserve road; busy road is separated by tree belt.
drivers.convention: Cars park here for sport; no sign of camping seen.

flags: Slope data covers the bank at the pin (about 8.7%), not the car park
Football club building 52 m away, non-residential
sun_shade: Car park is open with trees to the east giving morning shade.
cannot_judge: Any on-site signs or closing gate
